## Why we had to change

```{=html}
    <circle cx="480" cy="75" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
    <rect x="20" y="160" width="440" height="130" rx="14" class="aq3-card"/>
    <text x="70" y="225" class="why-icon">🔀</text>
    <text x="115" y="208" class="why-title">Manual docs drift</text>
    <text x="115" y="242" class="why-sub">out of sync with the code</text>
    <circle cx="20" cy="225" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>

    <text x="470" y="361" class="aq3-text aq3-on-pill">We needed an <tspan class="why-strong">automated · repeatable · scalable</tspan> approach</text>

```

::: notes
This shift was important for several reasons. First, accumulating "validation debt" can delay releases and increase risk, as teams are left with a large amount of qualification work at the end of the cycle. Second, when qualification is deferred, it becomes much harder to reconstruct what was tested, why it was tested, and what evidence supports the results. Finally, manually maintained qualification documents often drift out of sync with the code itself, creating additional maintenance challenges. In some cases, teams may even avoid adopting new releases or updates simply to avoid the burden of re-qualification. These challenges highlighted the need for a more automated, repeatable, and scalable approach, which ultimately drove our effort to redesign the entire qualification framework.
:::
